title: Mini Project: Online Store ke Relationships
objectives: Poore store ka schema relationships ke saath design karna
Seed aur eager loading ke saath data dikhana

sections.heading: Store ka naksha
sections.body:
Hum ek chhota online store bana rahe hain jisme yeh relationships hain:

- `Category` **hasMany** `Product`; `Product` **belongsTo** `Category`
- `User` **hasMany** `Order`; `Order` **belongsTo** `User`
- `Order` **belongsToMany** `Product` (pivot `order_product`: quantity, price)

Is lesson mein yeh sab ek saath jodte hain.

sections.body: Order of migrations: categories, products, orders, order_product (parent pehle).

errors.error: SQLSTATE[23000]: Integrity constraint violation: 1452 Cannot add or update a child row
errors.cause: Foreign key ki value (jaise `category_id`) ka parent record maujood nahi.
errors.fix: Pehle parent (category) banao, ya seeder ke order ko theek karo.

errors.error: Order ka total galat aa raha hai
errors.cause: `withPivot('quantity','price')` nahi likha ya pivot mein asli price store nahi kiya.
errors.fix: Relationship mein `withPivot` jodo aur attach karte waqt price do.

errors.error: Order adhura ban gaya (products nahi jude par stock kam hua)
errors.cause: Transaction nahi lagaya, beech mein error aaya.

interview.q: Online store ka relationship design samjhao.
interview.a: Category hasMany Product, User hasMany Order, Order belongsToMany Product pivot (quantity, price) ke saath.

interview.q: Order ke saath price pivot mein kyun?
interview.a: Order ke waqt ka price safe rakhne ke liye, taaki baad mein price badalne par history na badle.

interview.q: Order banate waqt transaction kyun zaroori hai?
interview.a: Order, pivot rows aur stock update ek saath hone chahiye, warna data inconsistent ho sakta hai.

interview.q: `withCount` aur `with` ko page par kaise use karte hain?
interview.a: `with('category')` N+1 se bachata hai, `withCount('products')` ginti ek query mein deta hai.

interview.q: `total` ko accessor mein kyun rakhte hain?
interview.a: Business logic model mein rehti hai, controller patla rehta hai, aur `with('products')` ke saath extra query nahi chalti.

summary: Schema: categories, products, orders, order_product (parent pehle).
Pivot mein order ke waqt ka price store karo.
